newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cologne air cargo up 1.6 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Cologne air cargo up 1.6 pct in February.

text.p: Total flown air cargo handled at Cologne/Bonn (CGN) in February rose 1.6 percent to 27,182 tonnes, figures from the German airports association ADV showed.
But this was a slowdown in growth following a three percent January rise in flown air cargo at the airport, the monthly ADV traffic report showed.
Exports at Cologne airport slowed slightly to 5.3 percent year-on-year growth in February after 6.2 percent growth in January.
Imports improved to a three percent year-on-year fall following a 5.3 percent decline in January.
